line_1.speaker: Ivo Kell
line_1.text: Received: one measure of daylight. Issued: nothing. It says that four hundred times in the same hand, and the hand gets no less steady.

line_2.speaker: Ivo Kell
line_2.text: Into the lattice, into the ice, into the reliquaries. Into people, latterly. The Keeping worked. It is the returning that was never drafted.

line_3.speaker: Ivo Kell
line_3.text: An entry that keeps being reopened. You are relit from the store each time. That is not a threat. It is a debit.

gated.speaker: Ivo Kell
gated.text: You have stood in the chapel. Then you have seen the last entry, or the place where it will go. He leaves the line clear. He is very tidy.

start.speaker: Ivo Kell
start.text: Ivo Kell has taken a corner of the tower and made it look lived in, which is more than the tower has managed on its own.

choices.text: Then where did the light go?
What am I, in the ledger?
I have been to the chapel.
Open the vault ledger to me.

ivo_arc.speaker: Ivo
ivo_arc.text: It is not a favour. It is the job, and nobody has asked me to do the job in eleven years. Bring what you cannot carry and I will find it again when you want it, in ink, under your name.
